id: title:Gilbert09:replace the raw meta response for an advantage creative rejection

review.posthog_relevance: Adds specific error handling and user-facing messaging for Meta Advantage+ ad creative failures in the warehouse connector, improving diagnostic clarity and preventing transient retry behavior for this specific API response.
review.reason: The change adds a new entry to the retry-exhausted error dictionary with a specific subcode and user-facing message, and includes a corresponding test case. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement in the warehouse connector's ability to recognize and communicate a specific Meta API error, rather than treating it as a generic transient failure. review.uncertainty: The actual production impact and user benefit depend on the frequency and severity of this specific Meta API error, which is not established by the code alone. The score is assigned based on the implementation of a specific error handling capability, not on demonstrated adoption or incident avoidance.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains two hunks. P1.F1.H1 adds a new error subcode and its user-facing message to the retry-exhausted error dictionary. P1.F2.H1 adds a corresponding test case. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new entry to the retry-exhausted error dictionary, mapping subcode 2446211 to a specific user-facing message.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog's Meta Ads warehouse connector to recognize a specific Meta API error and display a localized, actionable message to users instead of the raw API response, rather than treating it as a generic transient error. This could help users understand why their Advantage+ ad creative failed and what action to take (fix in Ads Manager).

observations.behavior: Adds a test case asserting that the new error subcode and its message are correctly recognized and displayed.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection for the new error handling behavior, ensuring that when Meta returns this specific subcode, PostHog correctly identifies it and does not treat it as a transient retryable error.
